title: Connected Accounts
subtitle: Connect your social media accounts to start syncing stats automatically.

alerts.workspace_preparing: Your client workspace is still being prepared. Please refresh the page and try again.

help.title: How it works:
help.step_1: Click a Connect button → you'll be redirected to log in to that platform
help.step_3: You'll be brought back here — data starts syncing automatically
help.step_4: Facebook & Instagram share one login. YouTube & Google My Business share one login.

modal.title: Connect Your Facebook & Instagram
modal.subtitle: To continue, please review and approve the permissions below. You'll be redirected to Facebook to confirm.
modal.legal_prefix: By continuing, you agree to our
modal.legal_suffix: . You can revoke access anytime in your Facebook settings.

pages_show_list.label: Access your Facebook Pages list
pages_show_list.description: We'll show the Pages you manage so you can choose which one to connect.
pages_show_list.technical: Meta scope pages_show_list: returns the list of Pages the user is an admin of via /me/accounts.

pages_read_engagement.label: Read Page engagement data
pages_read_engagement.description: We'll display your followers, likes, and post performance metrics in your dashboard.
pages_read_engagement.technical: Meta scope pages_read_engagement: read fan_count, followers_count, post insights, and reactions on a Page.

instagram_manage_insights.label: Read Instagram insights
instagram_manage_insights.description: We'll connect your linked Instagram Business account and pull engagement, reach, and impressions metrics for your dashboard.
instagram_manage_insights.technical: Meta scope instagram_manage_insights: read insights (engagement, reach, impressions, profile visits, follower demographics) for a linked IG Business account.

errors.load_facebook: Could not load Facebook. Please refresh and try again.
